title: George H.W. Bush, George W. Bush and Cheney's role in the legacy program

tellings.quote: George HW Bush as the director of CIA uh was read in allegedly to this uh legacy so-called legacy program and that um and that he passed on what he knew about that to his son George W.

plain: George H.W. Bush, while he was director of the CIA in 1976, was allegedly told about a so-called legacy program, a secret effort said to hold recovered non-human craft, and later passed what he knew to his son George W. Bush, with Vice President Dick Cheney also said to have a role. Kurt McConnell, a former US Senate staffer, relays this as something he attributes to David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who has testified about such programs. If true, it would mean the secret ran through the CIA and the White House for decades.
